disclaimer.general: Finandex presents historical data for information and education. It is not investment advice, a solicitation to buy or sell securities or crypto assets, or financial or legal advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Data is not real-time and may contain errors from its sources.
disclaimer.law: Legal information based on the available documents; not legal advice and not a substitute for a lawyer. For real cases, contact a lawyer or a Legal Aid Institute (LBH). In an emergency, call 112.
disclaimer.cryptoBot: Trading bots and yield pools are high-risk, including total loss of funds. Finandex does not recommend or affiliate with any bot/protocol. Never share a seed phrase or private key.
disclaimer.sample: Statistics from a data sample; not a job offer, property valuation, or personal financial plan.
disclaimer.trademark: NASDAQ®, S&P 500®, IDX, IHSG, exchange names, coin/protocol names, merchant names, and other marks belong to their respective owners. Finandex is not affiliated with, sponsored, or endorsed by Nasdaq, Inc., S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC, PT Bursa Efek Indonesia, Otoritas Jasa Keuangan, Bank Indonesia, or any other trademark owner.
disclaimer.short: Historical data for education — not investment, financial, or legal advice.
disclaimer.mylaiwyer: Legal information based on the available official documents; not legal advice and not a substitute for a lawyer. For real cases, contact a lawyer or a Legal Aid Institute. In an emergency, call 112.
disclaimer.finlaiwyer: Financial and banking law information based on the available official documents; not legal advice. Finandex is not affiliated with OJK, Bank Indonesia, IASC, or Polri, does not forward reports, and cannot recover funds. Criminal penalties may have been adjusted by Law 1/2026.
disclaimer.antiscamdex: Public information from OJK, Bank Indonesia, Satgas PASTI, and the IASC portal, summarised by Finandex. Finandex is not IASC and is not affiliated with those institutions. Official reports only at iasc.ojk.go.id. Never share your OTP, PIN, or password.

law.scamIntro: Pick what is closest to what happened. You will get immediate steps, official reporting channels, and the legal basis quoted from the regulations.
law.scamPlaceholder: Example: someone posing as my bank asked for my OTP and then my balance was drained…
law.urgent: Important: call your bank right away to block, then report to IASC (iasc.ojk.go.id) and the police. Never share OTPs, PINs, or passwords.
law.financeIntro: 19 official texts: P2SK Law & its amendment, OJK, Banking, Bank Indonesia, LPS, Consumer Protection, Fund Transfer, AML, EIT, PDP, the 2023 Criminal Code, OJK Regs 22/2023, 12/2024, 40/2024, BI Reg 3/2023.
law.guidedIntro: Pick the closest situation. Answer a few short questions (buttons or keys 1–9); the result is ordered steps, official channels, and the legal basis. No name, ID, account number, or OTP is asked.
law.keysHint: Press 1–9 to choose; tap the trail above to go back.
law.lg_edges: Lines: blue = amends, red dashed = revokes, yellow dotted = penalty adjusted
law.mapHint: Click a node (or pick from the list) to see status, changes, and key provisions.
law.pendingText: Official text not yet available — catalogue reference only.
law.sourcesCount: {{n}} of {{total}} documents available (official text ingested and verified).

agents.title: Agent Room
agents.intro: Every Dex runs as its own AI agent: {{agents}} agents (1 Conductor, 29 Dex agents, Verifier, Guard) with {{skills}} skills. Ask a question and watch the agents work — every movement in the office comes from a real event.
agents.partial: Some agents did not finish — partial answer.
agents.actionsHint: Agents only suggest actions; nothing runs until you confirm.
agents.officeHint: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom; click an agent for details. "Follow the action" turns off when you move the camera.
agents.reducedNote: Reduced motion: static camera, no walking or flying cards; status stays visible on monitors, floor rings and labels.
agents.noWebgl: This device does not support WebGL — agent status is shown as a list.
agents.logEmpty: No activity yet. Ask a question.
agents.askPlaceholder: Ask anything — even across domains, e.g. "scammed + rupiah rate + fraud article"
agents.needConsent: Open a chat once and accept the chat terms first.
agents.evalNote: Results of npm run eval:agents as of {{date}} (data mode, no AI model). Live-model evaluation needs an API key.
agents.evalLatencyNote: Data mode on the build machine; AI mode is slower.
